features.feature_value: Generally allows unless content incites violence or attacks a person/group; emphasizes free speech
features.evidence_span: I always allow comments unless they incite violence or attack a specific person or group.
features.rationale: The participant states a rule for keeping content by default with specific removal triggers.

features.feature_value: Only removes when wording could lead to violence
features.evidence_span: when verbiage could potentially lead to violence.
features.rationale: They explicitly tie removal to violence-risk phrasing.

features.feature_value: Judges whether posts could harm people who see them vs being harmless
features.evidence_span: whether the posts could result in harm to people who saw them, or if they were harmless
features.rationale: They describe a harm/harmlessness evaluation criterion.

features.feature_value: Supports speech in general but allows removal for misinformation or hate speech
features.evidence_span: unless there is misinformation or hate speech involved, it should be okay
features.rationale: They set boundaries for when speech should be moderated/removed.

features.feature_value: Supports moderation/removal for misinformation, racist/threatening rhetoric, or incitement to violence
features.evidence_span: for misinformation, racist/threatening rhetoric or inciting violence.
features.rationale: They enumerate specific disallowed content types that justify removal.

features.feature_value: Tries to see a balanced argument and treats Democrat vs Republican framing as not determinative
features.evidence_span: It didn't matter if it was from a Democrat or a Republican.
features.rationale: They describe a strategy that de-centers party identity when comparing the pair.

features.feature_value: Puts the pair together to assess how they are the same but different
features.evidence_span: Was putting them together to see how they were the same, but different
features.rationale: They explicitly characterize the act of pairing as a similarity/difference comparison.

features.feature_value: Removes due to perceived toxicity/evil; emotionally framed assessment of political views
features.evidence_span: the republican view was so toxic and evil I had to remove it.
features.rationale: Their decision is strongly grounded in an affective evaluation of toxicity.
